modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: VanVleet (right knee injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.
injury.detail: VanVleet will sit out the front end of this back-to-back set, with his next opportunity to play coming Monday at Miami. With the veteran floor general sidelined, Reed Sheppard, Bogdan Bogdanovic and Bruce Thornton are candidates for increased playing time, while Amen Thompson figures to see increased on-ball duties.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (back) won't play in Sunday's game against Houston, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Johnson is battling a sore back, so he will miss his second game of the 2026-27 campaign. Without him, Bub Carrington and Will Riley are candidates for more minutes.

injury.shortComment: Smith (finger) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Smith didn't play in Saturday's 117-106 win over Minnesota. Nic Claxton (hamstring) also didn't suit up in that one, resulting in Zach Collins getting the start. Claxton is good to go for Monday's meeting with the Cavaliers, so he will likely start if Smith doesn't get on the floor.

injury.shortComment: Tyson (ankle) is questionable for Monday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Tyson is questionable to play due to right ankle injury management. The third-year wing missed six games with the ailment but has appeared in three consecutive outings, including a Friday and Saturday night back-to-back in which he played a combined 64 minutes. If he is sidelined Monday, Tyrese Proctor, Mario Hezonja and Meleek Thomas will all get increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Larsson (illness) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Rockets.
injury.detail: Larsson has missed the last two games due to an illness, and he's in jeopardy of sitting out a third straight with the ailment. His status in practice tomorrow should clear things up prior to tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Watson (abdominal soreness) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Watson missed Saturday's 127-117 win over Dallas due to a hamstring injury, but he's now dealing with right abdominal soreness. Tyrese Proctor, Mario Hezonja and Meleek Thomas will see an uptick in minutes if Watson remains sidelined Monday.

injury.shortComment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Smart, who was ejected from Wednesday's game for punching Charles Bassey, will begin serving his suspension Friday night against the Jazz, meaning he'll be eligible to return Wednesday versus Indiana. Bruce Thornton and Reed Sheppard should be in line for more minutes while Smart serves his three-game ban.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (right foot injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Embiid will sit out the front end of this back-to-back set. With Adem Bona (back) and Dominick Barlow (back) sidelined, Dean Wade, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall could all see increased playing time, while LeBron James could also see more time at the five as well.

injury.shortComment: Stewart is questionable for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.
injury.detail: Stewart has started the last two games for Memphis, but he could miss Monday's game due to an illness. If he is unavailable, Taylor Hendricks could see extra minutes.

injury.shortComment: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against New Orleans due to right ankle inflammation.
injury.detail: Santos appears to have put a lingering knee injury behind him, but he's now experiencing an issue with his right ankle. He'll presumably test the injury in shootaround and pregame to determine whether he can suit up for Monday's game.

injury.shortComment: Edey (ankle) is questionable for Monday's game against Washington.
injury.detail: Edey is in danger of missing a third straight matchup as he works back from a left ankle injury. The team should have another update on his availability as tipoff approaches.
